svg.text: FIG 12 — THE HONEY CHAIN TRUST BOUNDARY
Disciplined engineering distinction between cryptographic proof and physical physical boundaries
✅ WHAT HONEY CHAIN CAN PROVE
1. Empirical Hive Environment During Production
• Brood temperature maintenance (TMP117 ±0.1°C).
• Nectar weight accumulation curve from load cells.
• Continuous acoustic energy bands from on-node FFT.
2. Exact Chain-of-Custody Provenance
• Which KVIC registered beekeeper extracted the batch.
• Geographical apiary GPS location and botanical flora.
• Exact extraction timestamp and curing duration.
3. Tamper-Evident Ledger Integrity
• Historical events cannot be retroactively modified.
• Lab test certificate hash is permanently bound.
4. Cloned Label & Scan Velocity Anomalies
• Flags duplicated QR tokens scanned across sessions.
• Detects impossible geographic scan velocity.
❌ WHAT HONEY CHAIN CANNOT PROVE
1. Chemical Contents Outside Accredited Testing
• A QR code cannot chemically inspect the liquid inside.
• Liquid authenticity relies on certified lab testing
and intact physical tamper-evident bottle seals.
2. Human Fraud at Initial Point of Lab Entry
• If a corrupt technician submits fraudulent moisture data,
the ledger faithfully seals that fraudulent data.
• Mitigation: Technician credentials are bound for forensic audit.
3. Physical Unbroken Jar Custody at Retail
• If a consumer buys a jar with an already broken neck seal,
the software cannot physically reconstruct the glass.
4. Definitive Microbiological Diagnosis
• Acoustic & thermal anomalies indicate colony risk,
not an automated substitute for laboratory PCR.
Jury Defense Takeaway:
Honey Chain establishes an authentic digital chain-of-custody. By openly acknowledging its trust boundary, the project demonstrates mature engineering credibility over marketing hype.
